This
fluorescent
lipophilic
dye
is
presumed
to

brightly
stain

outer

Moreover ,
it
is
believed
to
become
internalized
into

synaptic
vesicles ,
causing
nerve

to

intensely .
Although
it
is
water - soluble ,
it
will

aqueous

Injection .
Each
larva
was
placed
in
a
Petri
dish
and
submerged
in
1.5 %
agarose
gel ,
and
then

anesthetized
with
[ ?? % ]
tricaine
methanesulfonate
( Sigma ,
St.
Louis ,
MO ) .
The
dish
was
then
placed

under
a
dissection
microscope ,
and
the
larva
was
pressure - injected
with
FM
1-43FX
dye
using
a

microelectrode
produced
on
a
microcapillary
tube
puller .
In
general ,
the
microelectrode
was
inserted

twice :
once
on
each
side
of
the
bilateral
axis ,
along
the
imaginary
line
connecting
the
outer
back

edges
of
larva's
eyes .
Following
injection ,
the
fish
was
returned
to
its
system
water
in
order
to
let

dye

ventricular

and

cell
membranes .

20x ,

100x .
In

4
